docs.title: ALUMINUM — An LLM Unified Mesh
docs.text:
ALUMINUM aggregates Argo, ALCF, AskSage, and local Ollama (including Ollama cloud models) behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

The translation mesh is llm-rosetta-gateway, served by default on port 46701.

ALUMINUM itself is a configuration & orchestration layer:

  • detects which upstream services are alive,
  • walks you through service + model selection in the terminal,
  • generates config.jsonc for llm-rosetta-gateway,
  • launches and monitors the whole mesh.

No gateway logic is re-implemented here. If you only need protocol translation, use llm-rosetta(-gateway) directly; if you need one-command multi-service aggregation with docs, use ALUMINUM.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Argo :8101 ─┐
ALCF :8102 ─┼─► llm-rosetta-gateway :46701 ─► agents / SDKs / Claude Code
AskSage :8103┤   (OpenAI + Anthropic compat, llm-rosetta IR)
Ollama :8104┘

docs.title: Why an orchestration layer?
docs.text:
Each upstream already ships its own proxy (argo-proxy, alcf-proxy, asksage-proxy, ollama serve). What is missing is:

  • uniform discovery (which services are up? which models exist?),
  • uniform naming (argo:…, alcf:…, asksage:…, ollama:…),
  • one generated config for the gateway instead of hand-edited JSONC,
  • one CLI (aluminum) that works the same on every machine.

docs.title: Module map
docs.text: Module Responsibility aluminum.backends backend registry, curated fallbacks, mesh naming aluminum.detect HTTP probing + live model listing aluminum.gateway config.jsonc builder, writer, launcher aluminum.ports port resolution (explicit flag > ALUM_*_PORT env > placeholder) aluminum.config shared constants (mesh_base_url) aluminum.cli doctor / setup / serve / status / models / show

docs.title: Port conventions
docs.text:
Backend defaults are placeholders, not real ports — set yours via aluminum setup prompts, --argo-port/--alcf-port/--asksage-port/--ollama-port flags, or ALUM_ARGO_PORT / ALUM_ALCF_PORT / ALUM_ASKSAGE_PORT / ALUM_OLLAMA_PORT env vars.

Service Placeholder Env var Ollama 8104 ALUM_OLLAMA_PORT Argo proxy 8101 ALUM_ARGO_PORT ALCF proxy 8102 ALUM_ALCF_PORT AskSage proxy 8103 ALUM_ASKSAGE_PORT ALUMINUM mesh 46701 ALUM_PORT / --port

Bind the mesh to 127.0.0.1 and expose it remotely only via ssh -L (see Operations).

docs.title: Backends
docs.text:
Setup discovers models local-first, so every offered id is routable through the local proxy. Fallback order per backend:

Backend 1st: local proxy 2nd fallback 3rd: curated Argo :8101/v1/models — ✅ ALCF :8102/v1/models alcf-proxy models --json (owns Globus auth; see inference-endpoints docs) ✅ AskSage :8103/v1/models cached ~/.config/asksage_proxy/available_models.json (API docs) ✅ Ollama :8104/api/tags auto-start ollama serve if down, then re-check ✅

Argo prod vs local ids differ

The production catalogue uses display-style ids (Claude Opus 5) while the local proxy serves routable ids (argo:claude-opus-5). When the local proxy is unavailable, the wizard uses curated local IDs rather than offering production catalogue IDs that may not route through the proxy.

docs.title: Argo (argo-proxy)
docs.text:
• Single gateway provider block argo (openai_chat → /v1). argo-proxy natively serves both /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages, so one block covers GPT- and Claude-flavoured models; the mesh translates the other protocol on the fly (verified live for both directions).
  • Mesh names keep the argo: prefix.
  • Serve hint: argo-proxy serve. Config lives at ~/.config/argoproxy/config.yaml.

docs.title: ALCF (alcf-proxy)
docs.text:
• Single openai_chat provider block pointed at /v1.
  • Model list comes from the cluster scheduler (Sophia/Metis/Minerva, vLLM).
  • Serve hint: alcf-proxy serve.

docs.title: AskSage (asksage-proxy)
docs.text:
• Single openai_chat provider block (AskSage).
  • Requires a personal API key and the ANL cert (asksage_anl_gov.pem). Never commit keys — the wizard never writes secrets, only dummy placeholders plus model routing (auth lives in each proxy's own config).
  • Serve hint: asksage-proxy. Config at ~/.config/asksage_proxy/config.yaml.

docs.title: Ollama
docs.text:
• Local daemon; also serves Ollama cloud models (*:cloud) after ollama signin. Cloud entries appear with size - in ollama list.
  • Model discovery uses /api/tags (different schema from /v1/models); ALUMINUM normalises both to a plain id list.
  • Serve hint: ollama serve.

docs.title: Adding a new backend
docs.text:
1. Add an entry to REGISTRY in src/aluminum/backends.py (key, label, port, gateway provider block, models URL).
  2. Add curated fallbacks in CURATED_MODELS.
  3. Extend mesh_name() prefix mapping.
  4. Document the service in this page.

docs.title: CLI Reference
docs.text:
aluminum --help
aluminum doctor [--timeout 5.0] [--argo-port N] [--alcf-port N] [--asksage-port N] [--ollama-port N]
aluminum setup [-c CONFIG] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 46701] [--argo-port N] [--alcf-port N] [--asksage-port N] [--ollama-port N] [--yes] [--no-banner]
aluminum serve [-c CONFIG] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port N] [--no-banner]
aluminum status [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port N]
aluminum models [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port N] [--json]
aluminum show [-c CONFIG]
aluminum version

Backend ports resolve as: CLI flag > ALUM_ARGO_PORT / ALUM_ALCF_PORT / ALUM_ASKSAGE_PORT / ALUM_OLLAMA_PORT env vars > built-in placeholders (8101–8104). Setup, status, and models resolve the mesh port as: --port > ALUM_PORT > 46701. Serve preserves the port in its config unless --port is supplied.

docs.title: doctor
docs.text: Probe every registered backend plus the mesh gateway. Exit code is always 0; read the ✅/❌ table.

docs.title: setup
docs.text: Interactive wizard (four steps: port → services → models → confirm). Service and model steps use arrow-key checkboxes: ↑↓ to move, space to toggle, enter to submit. Nothing is pre-selected — submit empty to abort. Each selected backend prompts for its local proxy port (flag/env/placeholder default). The final step asks for confirmation before overwriting. Writes ~/.config/llm-rosetta-gateway/config.jsonc with a .jsonc.bak backup. --yes skips prompts using live backends + curated models. When stdin is not a TTY (pipes, CI), selection falls back to numbered input.

docs.title: serve
docs.text: Execs llm-rosetta-gateway --config <path> [--host …] [--port …] in the foreground. Without --port, the configured port is preserved; the option overrides it. Run it under tmux, screen, or systemd for persistence (see Operations). Upstream proxies must already be running.

docs.title: status / models
docs.text: status prints gateway uptime, request counters and per-provider success rate / latency (from /health). models lists the unified model catalogue (from /v1/models); --json dumps raw JSON for scripting.

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
Is ALUMINUM a fork of llm-rosetta-gateway? No. ALUMINUM generates its config and launches it. Protocol translation stays entirely in llm-rosetta.

Why port 46701? It is just the default. Override it with aluminum setup (Step 1), --port, or the ALUM_PORT env var.

Can I use ALUMINUM on a machine with only some backends? Yes — that is the point. aluminum doctor shows what is reachable; aluminum setup only offers reachable services (plus curated fallbacks you can deselect).

Where are secrets stored? Nowhere in ALUMINUM. API keys and certs live in each proxy's own config (argo-proxy, alcf-proxy, asksage-proxy, ollama). The generated config.jsonc only contains dummy placeholders and routing.

How do I add a backend? See Backends → "Adding a new backend". It is a ~10-line change in src/aluminum/backends.py.

docs.title: Remote access via SSH tunnel
docs.text:
Bind everything to 127.0.0.1. Never expose an unauthenticated proxy on 0.0.0.0. From your laptop:

ssh -N -L 46701:127.0.0.1:46701 user@server
curl http://localhost:46701/v1/models

For flaky networks use autossh -M 0 -N -L ….

docs.title: Persistence
docs.text:
Simplest (interactive hosts):

tmux new -s aluminum
aluminum serve
# Ctrl+B, D to detach

Stable (servers), as a user systemd unit ~/.config/systemd/user/aluminum.service:

[Unit]
Description=ALUMINUM mesh gateway
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/aluminum serve
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

systemctl --user enable --now aluminum

docs.title: Client wiring
docs.text:
OpenAI-compatible tools (Aider, Cursor, Python SDK):

export OPENAI_BASE_URL="http://localhost:46701/v1"
export OPENAI_API_KEY="dummy"

Claude Code:

export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://localhost:46701/v1"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="dummy"

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Gateway up, model errors — check aluminum status provider table; the failing upstream (Argo/ALCF/AskSage/Ollama) is usually down or its key/cert expired.
  • AskSage SSL errors — verify cert_path in ~/.config/asksage_proxy/config.yaml points at a valid asksage_anl_gov.pem.
  • Ollama cloud models missing — run ollama signin, then ollama list.

docs.title: 1. Install
docs.text:
pip install -e ".[all]"

For docs tooling:

pip install -e ".[docs]"
mkdocs serve

docs.title: 2. Check the machine
docs.text:
aluminum doctor

Expected: one row per backend (argo, alcf, asksage, ollama) plus the mesh gateway on 127.0.0.1:46701. Tell ALUMINUM where your proxies live via flags (--argo-port …), env vars (ALUM_ARGO_PORT … — see Architecture), or the setup prompts. ❌ rows simply mean that proxy is not running (or the port is wrong) — the wizard still offers curated fallbacks.

docs.title: 3. Run the wizard
docs.text:
aluminum setup

Four steps:

  1. Port — mesh gateway port (default 46701); warns if occupied.
  2. Pick services — checkbox-style numbered list; nothing pre-selected.
  3. Proxy ports + models — one port prompt per selected service, then model checkboxes fetched live from each /v1/models (Ollama via /api/tags); curated fallbacks apply when a backend is down.
  4. Confirm — writes ~/.config/llm-rosetta-gateway/config.jsonc (previous file is backed up to .jsonc.bak).

Non-interactive equivalent (CI / containers):

aluminum setup --yes

docs.title: 4. Serve the mesh
docs.text:
aluminum serve

Then point any client at the mesh:

export OPENAI_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:46701/v1"
export OPENAI_API_KEY="dummy"

docs.title: 5. Verify
docs.text:
aluminum status
aluminum models
curl http://127.0.0.1:46701/v1/models
